transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our capital-return review started on the potential share repurchase. As you all know, the board has authorized us to consider repurchasing up to 5,000,000 common shares this quarter, and we have the cash position to support it. Before I finalize any authorization, I need input from each of your areas. Treasury, I'd like your read on cash flow and liquidity. Legal and compliance, I need to understand any regulatory constraints on the offer structure. And IR, please give me a sense of how shareholders and the market might react. Let's work through this systematically.
